posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
Better to use this

alias ptc='find /opt/se2001/$(basename "\$PWD")/ -type f -name "*put.txt" | grep public | sort | while read -r filename; do batcat "$filename"; done'

note: escaping \$PWD delays evaluation until execution time.

ptc() {
    find /opt/se2001/"$(basename "$PWD")"/ -type f -name "*put.txt" \
    | grep public \
    | sort \
    | while read -r filename; do
        batcat "$filename"
    done
}
